meta.title: Regret Item writes "Regret" into every vendor response for the item

steps.note: Create a Technical Stage event, which is the subject of the test.
Work on the Technical Stage tab where the RFI builder is available.
Apply a technical template so the questionnaire and line-item response fields are rendered.
Create the required line item whose vendor responses will be regretted.
Set up a participating vendor for the response fields.

args.goal: On the Technical Stage RFI builder, open Quick Fill for the line item, click Regret Item, and verify that every Vendor Responses field for that item shows Regret

steps.note: Perform the catalog-missing Regret Item action and verify its effect on every vendor response field.
Confirm the resulting Regret value is visible on the Technical Stage screen.
